story: Nia wanted to water the sunflower, but the tomato seedlings were thirsty. Mr Bell said, “The tap is broken.” The rain barrel held one can of water. Nia told Mr Bell, “I want to water the sunflower first.” Using the watering can, she watered the sunflower. The shade cloth fell. The tomato seedlings had a brown leaf. Nia secured the umbrella above the tomato seedlings with the garden tie. Mr Bell fixed the tap. Nia watered the tomato seedlings with water from the tap. Mrs Okafor fixed the shade cloth with the clip. Nia said, “I promise I'll water the tomato seedlings first tomorrow.” The brown leaf remained under the repaired shade cloth.
